name: SWI/SNF-related matrix-associated actin-dependent regulator of chromatin subfamily D member 1 (60 kDa BRG-1/Brm-associated factor subunit A) (BRG1-associated factor 60A) (BAF60A) (SWI/SNF complex 60 kDa subunit)
features: Interaction with ESR1, NR1H4, NR3C1, PGR and SMARCA4
Necessary for GR/NR3C1-mediated remodeling and transcription from chromatin; required for GR/NR3C1 interaction with the BRG1/SMARCA4 complex in vivo
Glycyl lysine isopeptide (Lys-Gly) (interchain with G-Cter in SUMO2)
